name: How long does a garage-to-living-space conversion take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a garage-to-living-space conversion take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a garage conversion typically ranges from 4 to 12 weeks, though this can vary. Factors influencing the duration include the project's complexity, the extent of structural modifications, the permitting process, material lead times, and the speed of inspections. A simple conversion without extensive plumbing or electrical work will generally be quicker than a complex ADU that requires new utility connections. We provide a detailed project schedule after initial planning.
acceptedAnswer.description: A garage conversion usually takes 4-12 weeks, depending on complexity, structural changes, permitting, and material availability. Simpler projects are faster.
